reuse.why: Calls the existing exported getScheduledAmount with the raw schedule._amount, the same helper the forecast, schedule template and schedule services already use.

duplication.why: No logic is restated; the range/number/missing decision stays in the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated list entity type in api-models and the handler typing updated, leaving scheduleModel.toExternal (used elsewhere) unchanged.

scope.why: Handler, type, one test expectation and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Tiny, explicit change whose rule is owned by the shared helper.
